packageRules.description: guard-serverless-v3 is a required check on main that blocks a serverless v4 upgrade; keep Renovate from proposing one across the root, test-files and examples projects. Mirrors .github/dependabot.yml's old ignore rule.
examples/serverless-offline pins serverless-offline below v14 to match its serverless v3 dependency there. test-files/webpack-project already runs serverless-offline 14 and isn't affected.
